statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code CO-50
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias and assess efficacy of current management strategies
